info.title: Energy Audit Automation API
info.description: Commercial building energy screening API. EUI benchmarking vs EPA national medians. Multi-city Building Performance Standards penalty calculator — NYC LL97, Boston BERDO 2.0, Denver Energize Denver. Solar offset potential. Upgrade prioritisation. Every figure cited to its source.

post.description:
Quick energy audit from monthly cost + building type.
Estimates EUI from bill, benchmarks against EPA median,
calculates LL97 penalty exposure, identifies top upgrade.
Free plan.

Full commercial building energy audit.
Requires actual utility inputs (kWh + therms).
Returns EUI vs EPA median, multi-city BPS penalties (LL97/BERDO/Denver),
solar offset, and ranked upgrade measures — all cited to source.
Pro plan required.

property_type.title: Property Type
property_type.description: Building type. Use GET /reference/property-types for valid values.

sq_ft.description: Gross floor area in square feet.

annual_therms.title: Annual Therms
annual_therms.description: Annual natural gas consumption in therms. Use 0 for all-electric buildings.

city.title: City
city.description: BPS jurisdiction. Values: nyc, boston, denver, all

grid_region.title: Grid Region
grid_region.description: EPA eGRID region for electricity carbon factor. Values: NYISO, ISONE, PJM, WECC_CO, SERC, MISO, national

climate_zone.title: Climate Zone
climate_zone.description: US climate zone for solar estimation. Values: hot_arid, hot_humid, mixed, cold, marine

roof_pct.title: Roof Pct
roof_pct.description: Fraction of floor area that is usable roof for solar (0.05–1.0). Typical: 0.30–0.50.

elec_rate.title: Elec Rate
elec_rate.description: Electricity rate in USD/kWh. Default: $0.126 (EIA commercial average 2024).

gas_rate.title: Gas Rate
gas_rate.description: Natural gas rate in USD/kBtu. Default: $0.0127 (~$1.27/therm).
